outlets.name: ABC News Australia
outlets.summary: ABC is leading with the deadly flash flood on the Nepal-Tibet border that has left an Australian among hundreds missing, alongside a hospital fire that killed 14 babies in Pakistan and the RBA's renewed rate-hike risk as inflation data lands.

items.headline: An Australian is among hundreds missing after the Nepal-Tibet flash flood
items.detail: At least 22 people have been confirmed dead and nearly 300 foreign nationals, including an Australian, are reported missing after a torrent of water swept through the Himalayan border region.

items.headline: A hospital fire in Pakistan's capital kills 14 babies
items.detail: A blaze tore through a maternity ward in Islamabad, killing 14 infants, with witnesses saying the door to the ward was locked at the time.

items.headline: Ukraine awards Elon Musk the Order of Freedom for Starlink support
items.detail: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy honoured the tech billionaire for keeping Starlink satellite internet running for Ukraine during the war.

items.headline: July inflation data heightens the risk of an RBA rate hike
items.detail: Economists described the latest inflation figures as an unfortunate kick in the guts, raising the odds the Reserve Bank will lift rates again.

items.headline: The historic antisemitism inquiry closes with an impassioned plea
items.detail: The royal commission into antisemitism wrapped up its public hearings with a rabbi's emotional call for social cohesion in Australia.

outlets.name: SBS News Australia
outlets.summary: SBS is balancing the global reaction to Dolly Parton's death with domestic politics, including National Cabinet's push on AI data centre rules and the wrap-up of the antisemitism royal commission.
outlets.note: Homepage returned images only - headlines taken from the SBS News bulletin and Just In feeds.

items.headline: AI data centre rules face opposition at National Cabinet
items.detail: The federal government's push for national rules requiring large new data centres to underwrite renewable energy met resistance from the states.

items.headline: Country music icon Dolly Parton dies aged 80
items.detail: The legendary singer-songwriter died after a brief battle with cancer, prompting tributes from around the world.

items.headline: The antisemitism royal commission wraps up its public hearings
items.detail: Commissioner Bell said the inquiry now has enough material to reach its conclusions after examining sensitive evidence linked to the Bondi attack.

items.headline: NSW's gambling reforms draw criticism
items.detail: The state's new gambling measures have been criticised by advocates who argue they do not go far enough to curb harm.

items.headline: New South Wales unveils major gambling reforms
items.detail: The state announced sweeping changes to gambling rules, including tighter restrictions on advertising and inducements.

outlets.name: RNZ New Zealand
outlets.summary: RNZ's Wednesday file mixes crime and emergency stories with health and business news, including a free flu vaccine for under-fives and a $40m claim against Gloriavale's leader.

items.headline: A person is assaulted and a vehicle shot at after a two-car crash
items.detail: Police are investigating an incident in which a person was assaulted and a vehicle shot at following a collision between a Toyota and a Volkswagen.

items.headline: The flu vaccine is to be free for all children under five
items.detail: The government announced the free flu jab for under-fives as hospitalisations from the virus soar.

items.headline: Gloriavale leavers file a $40m lost wages claim against the Overseeing Shepherd
items.detail: Former members describe the community as modern day slavery in a claim for decades of unpaid wages and entitlements.

items.headline: Fire and Emergency is treating the large Wanaka blaze as suspicious
items.detail: Investigators are treating the major fire near Wanaka as suspicious as crews continue to battle the blaze.

items.headline: Ghislaine Maxwell loses her bid to overturn her US conviction
items.detail: The Jeffrey Epstein accomplice failed in her latest attempt to overturn her conviction in the United States.

outlets.name: South China Morning Post
outlets.summary: SCMP is leading on the landslide that destroyed a China-Nepal border crossing and Xi Jinping's expected visit to India, alongside US visa freezes and a Hong Kong court ruling on PwC and Evergrande.

items.headline: A landslide engulfs a China-Nepal border checkpoint causing major casualties
items.detail: The landslide began in Nepal's Rasuwa region and struck Tibet's Gyirong county, with Xi ordering authorities to spare no effort in the search for the missing.

items.headline: Xi Jinping is expected to visit India after seven years
items.detail: Sources caution against overplaying expectations, saying the offers on the table fall well short of a breakthrough or grand bargain.

items.headline: Frustration grows in China as the US freezes green card interviews worldwide
items.detail: Cancelled appointments mark the latest squeeze on legal immigration during Donald Trump's second term.

items.headline: PwC International must face trial over Evergrande claims, Hong Kong court rules
items.detail: Liquidators are seeking about 38 billion yuan from PwC International over alleged audit failures at the property giant.

items.headline: The delay to China's moon mission could ease pressure on Nasa
items.detail: The postponement of the especially ambitious Chang'e-7 mission was no surprise to space specialists, but the US agency will not be celebrating.

outlets.name: CNN
outlets.summary: CNN's front page is anchored by the Nepal flash flood disaster and the death of Dolly Parton, alongside Meta's landmark $18 billion child-harm settlement and the fallout from Trump's revived tariffs.

items.headline: Meta settles a landmark child harm case for $18 billion
items.detail: The company agreed to the settlement with US states and promised changes to its platforms over allegations of harm to children.

items.headline: Dolly Parton, country music queen and humanitarian, dead at 80
items.detail: The legendary singer died surrounded by loved ones, her representatives said, prompting tributes from around the world.

items.headline: At least 31 killed and hundreds missing in a huge flash flood on the Nepal-China border
items.detail: Nepal's foreign minister said a quake triggered a landslide that blocked a river, sending a torrent of water downstream.

items.headline: Trump gets a much-needed South Carolina win in Tuesday's elections
items.detail: The president's preferred candidate won the GOP Senate primary runoff, giving him a boost heading into the midterms.

items.headline: Trump spurs backlash from his own party after reviving unpopular tariffs
items.detail: Republicans are pushing back against the president's renewed tariff push as the trade war with Canada escalates.

outlets.name: Fox News
outlets.summary: Fox is leading with the death of Dolly Parton and the cause of her illness, alongside the Pakistan hospital fire, a manhunt arrest and primary results, with the Iran war and Smithsonian stories in the hot topics.
outlets.note: Homepage returned navigation only - headlines taken from Fox News Digital and the latest RSS feed.

items.headline: Country music legend Dolly Parton dead at 80
items.detail: Parton died Tuesday at 80 following a brief battle with cancer, her representatives confirmed.

items.headline: At least 14 newborns killed in a Pakistan nursery hospital fire
items.detail: A blaze swept through a hospital nursery in Pakistan, killing at least 14 newborn babies.

items.headline: The Philadelphia mask suspect is arrested in Las Vegas
items.detail: The man accused of terrorising people while wearing a Chucky mask was taken into custody in Las Vegas and faces extradition.

items.headline: Three Secret Service officials are under internal investigation
items.detail: The officials are being investigated over potential misconduct, Fox News reported.

items.headline: A conservative firebrand who went viral with an anti-CCP ad survives a key primary
items.detail: The candidate held on in a closely watched primary race, according to Fox News.

outlets.name: The Wall Street Journal
outlets.summary: The Journal is leading on Canada's retaliatory tariff package targeting US midterm states and the oil market's slide as Iran and Oman push to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
outlets.note: Paywalled - headlines via the Dow Jones World News RSS feed and dated article URLs.

items.headline: Canada hits back at the US with tariffs targeting midterm states
items.detail: Ottawa plans to impose tariffs of up to 50% on roughly 700 American products in retaliation for new US levies.

items.headline: Why oil prices are down 10% this week
items.detail: Crude has fallen sharply as Iran and Oman discuss reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Persian Gulf shipping insurance costs climb.

items.headline: GM says the Iran war and high gas prices are not denting sales
items.detail: The US automaker raised its adjusted profit guidance on lower tariff costs, saying demand for its large trucks and SUVs remains strong.

items.headline: What is getting hit with the new US-Canada tariffs
items.detail: New tariffs kicked in on billions of dollars' worth of US imports from Canada after trade talks between the two nations collapsed.
